extensions.name: Artwork
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: The artwork of the current track fills the window, under dark glass panels that float.

extensions.name: Output gain
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Adds a fixed gain to the decoded sound. The displayed volume does not change, and the kernel's ceiling applies.

extensions.name: Glass
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: A complete redesign: gradient and acrylic backgrounds, large rounded cards, larger text, buttons that grow on hover, shadows.

extensions.name: Greenroom
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: A familiar layout from another music app: the playback bar at the bottom across the window, the track on the left, rounded dark panels and a green accent.

extensions.name: Hello
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Minimal example: writes to the log and keeps a launch counter.

extensions.name: High contrast
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Black and white, with bright colors for buttons and selections.

extensions.name: Skip tracks from the keyboard
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Global shortcuts: Ctrl+Alt+Right for the next track, Ctrl+Alt+Left for the previous one.

extensions.name: Night blue
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Night blue theme, with a dark scheme and a light scheme.

extensions.name: Track notification
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Shows a notification for each new track. Does not touch the player.

extensions.name: Light paper
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Plain, light paper theme, with an optional dark scheme.

extensions.name: Rose gold
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Warm rose gold theme, with a dark scheme and a light scheme.

extensions.name: Sleep timer
extensions.author: Shirowwww
extensions.description: Pauses playback after a delay, set in minutes, then lets you know.
